value.name: Miles watches Court TV in bed
value.description: Miles lies in bed morosely watching Court TV, establishing his mood and idle state.
evidence: Miles is in bed, morosely watching Court TV.

value.name: Court TV interrupts coverage with verdict news
value.description: The broadcast interrupts weekend coverage to announce that a verdict has been reached in the Kentucky v Leonard case.
evidence: 'We are interrupting our scheduled weekend coverage because we have just received word there is a verdict in the Kentucky v Leonard Case. We now join the case -- live.'

value.name: Jury acquits Leonard of murder
value.description: In the courtroom, the jury returns a not guilty verdict on the first-degree murder charge.
evidence: 'Of the charges of murder in the first degree, we the jury find the defendant -- not guilty.'

value.name: Anchors comment on acquittal
value.description: Back in the studio, Nikki Rosen and her guest react to the acquittal as another example of a killer getting away with it.
evidence: Nikki turns to her guest host and says, 'He got away with it.'

value.name: Scene cuts to gangster Joe
value.description: The scene shifts to a perspiring gangster named Joe, who appears edgy and physically strained.
evidence: The scene cuts to a close-up of an edgy-looking gangster named Joe, perspiring heavily, breathing through his mouth with the rasping wheeze of an asthmatic.

value.name: Joe waits across the table
value.description: Joe stares across the table at someone off-screen, suggesting a tense meeting already underway.
evidence: His labored breath rattles as he stares across the table at someone off-screen.

value.name: Off-screen voice identifies Joe
value.description: A voice asks whether the man across the table is Joe, confirming the identity check in the meeting.

value.name: Joe uses his inhaler
value.description: Joe silently raises his inhaler, puts it in his mouth, and takes a puff to manage his breathing.
evidence: Without looking away, the gangster raises an inhaler, places it in his mouth, and squeezes. WHUSH.
